options.reason: The table holds transactional invoice lines with monetary and quantity fields but no column recording an outcome, so the evident aim is segmenting the purchasing behaviour of the entities that generate these events; aggregating line items to RFM-style customer features (recency, frequency, monetary value from Quantity x UnitPrice) and clustering yields behavioural customer segments. InvoiceNo is a record-level document key and is not a feature; no field is a derivative of a target because there is none. Timestamps are used only to build static recency features, so no chronological partition column is declared.
options.title: clustering
